_doc: People thanked in the About dialog's thanks list (map_template.contributor_names).
A name enters only as the visitor gave it to be credited: the `credit` of a
or an e-mail that asks for it. Added at triage when the report was acted on
(fixed, or confirmed and queued). Not added: a name that is offensive, impersonates
someone, or carries contact details or a link. Removed on request, no questions.
Fields: name (as given, at most 60 characters), added (ISO date), via (card | email),
slugs (the appellations the report concerned), report (one line: what it led to).
